data.description:
CONTEST SUBMISSIONS ARE CLOSED ⚡ REPOST your favorite tracks to VOTE!

Please check out our FAQs: https://www.warpsound.ai/remix-contest

TO VOTE: 
1. Listen to all remixes here: https://audius.co/warpsound_ai/reposts
2. Vote by REPOSTING your favorite tracks

TO WIN: 
Submissions will be voted on by the community. Top 9 songs* will then be evaluated by our panel of music makers & innovators. Who are these judges? Follow us on Twitter as we introduce them starting Feb 24. 

TIMELINE: 
Feb 23:  Contest begins
Mar 9:  Submissions end 11:59pm PST
Mar 10 - 13: Community vote
Mar 13:  Top 9 to judges
Mar 16: Winners announced

1st Place - 0.50 ETH (from WarpSound)
2nd Place - 0.25 ETH (from WarpSound)
3rd Place - 0.10 ETH (from WarpSound)
5 top entries - AUDIUS swag bag

*WarpSound reserves the right to pick the final top 9 in the event anyone attempts to manipulate the votes.
